text: Are you aware of our Manage Your Appointment App? It is a convenient way to view, reschedule, or cancel your appointment directly from your phone. I'll send you a text to the device you're calling from, so that you can get started. Is that alright?

setParameterActions.value: Bell: You can visit $session.params.mya_information_response.notification[0].MYAApplicationUrl to manage your appointment in the My Bell app. (bell.ca/about-us)
